verse.verse_1: READ IN THE name of your Lord who created,
verse.verse_3: Read, for your Lord is most beneficent,
verse.verse_5: Taught man what he did not know.
verse.verse_6: And yet, but yet man is rebellious,
verse.verse_7: For he thinks he is sufficient in himself.
verse.verse_8: Surely your returning is to your Lord.
verse.verse_9: Have you seen him who restrains
verse.verse_10: A votary when he turns to his devotions?
verse.verse_11: Have you thought, if he had been on guidance
verse.verse_12: Or had enjoined piety, (it would have been better)?
verse.verse_13: Have you thought that if he denies and turns away,
verse.verse_14: Does he not know that God sees?
verse.verse_15: And yet indeed if he does not desist We shall drag him by the forelock,
verse.verse_16: By the lying, the sinful forelock.
verse.verse_17: So let him call his associates,
verse.verse_18: We shall call the guards of Hell.
verse.verse_19: Beware! Do not obey him, but bow in adoration and draw near (to your Lord).
